credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Tish Frank sitting on the ground looking up at Georgia O'Keeffe in a white head scarf wearing a skirt and matching short sleeve jacket  sitting under the rock ledge. This photograph is from the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Tish Frank and Georgia O'Keeffe
